seriesStmt.title: Gregor Joseph Werner: A thematic catalogue of his works

annot.p: The copy in H-Gk is the only known complete source of this work. However, comparison to the autograph org part in H-Bn shows that several sections of the work have been revised in the H-Gk source, most likely by Benedek Istvánffy. Major differences are evident in the Kyrie, Gloria, and Credo, but not in the remaining movements. Here, extents are given for the H-Bn source, while the scoring has been deduced from the H-Gk source.
da capo of the first 15 bars
Sanctus and Benedictus form a single movement, and there is only a single Osanna, which is part of the latter movement.
